Qui s'est élevé à une condition sociale importante, souvent fortunée, en conservant des usages, des codes, des manières ou une culture assimilés à une classe sociale jugée comme étant inférieure.

examples.text: Un commerçant parvenu.

glosses: A person who has risen, climbed up, or has been promoted to a higher social class, especially through acquisition of wealth, privileges, or political authority but has not gained social acceptance by those within that new class.

examples.text: But the favourite's power and influence provoke intense ill-feeling among other courtiers, who regard him as a sinister, usurping parvenu with ideas above his station, or perhaps even a sorcerer.
